files_changed_self_report.rationale: Registered the new MCP tools during server initialization.
Added the seven MCP tool entrypoints, Pydantic models, error responses, logging, audit cache/circuit-breakers, and helper logic.
Documented the SCP-MCP-E0NN taxonomy and the 021C-defined concrete error codes.
Updated the handshake expectation from an empty tool list to the seven registered MCP tools.
Added consult_rules happy-path and validation-error coverage.
Added active, expired, and non-existent rule waiver coverage.
Added DECISIONS table parsing and `since` filter coverage.
Added finding lookup and not-found coverage.
Added happy-path, timeout, and diff-cap circuit-breaker coverage for audit_changed.
Added exact-match and fuzzy-match domain resolution coverage.
Added proposal creation and duplicate-proposal detection coverage.

self_reported_concerns: The MCP `audit_changed(base_ref?, head_ref?)` contract does not expose the explicit `domains`, `subsystem`, or `standards_version` arguments required by the existing CLI, so the implementation infers domains via `resolve_domain` and uses the repo directory name as the subsystem when invoking `audit-changed`.

The `propose` tool defaults to the runtime target `docs/reviews/proposals/PROP-NNN.md`, which matches the slice contract but sits outside the current repo-edit partition; tests therefore exercised the proposal logic against temporary directories instead of creating a repository proposal file.
`git status` showed an additional untracked file at `docs/reviews/WP-SCP-022/dispatches/021c/dispatcher-result.json` that was not created by this implementation pass.
codex_structured_result.summary: Implemented WP-SCP-022 Track 2 slice 021C by adding the MCP tool layer in `src/standards_control_plane/mcp_server/tools.py`, registering the seven tools from `server.py`, documenting the SCP-MCP-E0NN taxonomy in `docs/integrations/mcp-error-codes.md`, and adding per-tool tests under `tests/scp_mcp/test_tools/`. The implementation includes structured invocation logging, consult reuse, waiver and finding lookups, decision parsing, `audit_changed` timeout/diff-cap/cache handling, domain resolution heuristics, and the stub proposal writer with duplicate detection. Scoped verification passed with `python3 -m pytest tests/scp_mcp/ -xvs`.
